sources.title: Mandatory utility fees distort price signals for rooftop solar in the US
sources.excerpt: Regulators in 27 U.S. states are shifting residential electricity pricing toward higher fixed monthly charges and lower usage-based rates, weakening the economics of rooftop solar and home battery systems.
